name: Space Physics Laboratory
summary:
Step into orbit with NASA MMS, a hands-on VR experience that blends immersive simulation with real science. Designed in collaboration with NASA’s Magnetospheric Multiscale Mission, this interactive journey puts you inside a stylized space station environment filled with holograms, games, and physics.

Navigate using a jetpack orb as you explore the station’s environment. Dive into the data cube and use lasers to trace the invisible flow of charged particles as they interact with Earth’s magnetic field.
